title: Magnificent Montmorency Falls E-Bike Tour
includes: Choice of Urban Bike or E-bike( at least 18 years old)
Water. You may bring your own water bottle (eco responsable)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be able to ride a bike for approximately 16 miles (26 km) by themselves.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Montmorency Falls, higher then the Niagara Falls, is a must see for any tourist that visits Quebec City. Our qualified guides are fun, experienced, informative and passionate. They will being you to points of interest along the ride beginning with the Domaine de Maizerets, Bay of Beauport and a splendid view of the Saint Lawrence River with the scenic backdrop of Île d’Orléans. Visit the site on foot, follow the trail to the suspension bridge will gives you prime views of the roaring waterfall.
